root_cause.text: The vulnerability exists because the `replace_nexthop_single` function in the nexthop subsystem incorrectly limits `nh_group_v4_update` calls to IPv4-to-IPv6 transitions, failing to update group flags when transitioning from IPv6 to IPv4.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description identifies that "nh_group_v4_update is only called when replacing AF_INET to AF_INET6, but the reverse direction (AF_INET6 to AF_INET) is missed," while the patch diff corrects this by changing the condition from `oldi->family == AF_INET && newi->family == AF_INET6` to `oldi->family != newi->family`.
